name: newbyzantium
note: Our own WAD (newbyzantium.wad), shipped as a separate file listed in the map's .res, not embedded. Other games' textures (TS, HL, H9's AX/XC/MR, majestic.wad) are referenced by name in the map only and never enter this WAD. Format: levels/art/README.md. Built by levels/tools/art-kit.mjs.

params.msrHueNote: the MSR's colour, a hue in degrees for every purple panel and the MSR grade's harmony: 270 purple (today), about 215 for H9's MSR blue
params.wearNote: how worn each theme reads (the weather op's wear, 0-1): the MSR clean but aged, L2 used, L1 heavy, the mega-structure old

themes.msr: the MSR set: the regime's walls, floors, ceilings, trim, doors and cell bars (replaces majestic.wad's MJST*)
themes.msr-id: the MSR's identity: eagle, banners, posters, plaque, screen, checkpoint stripe
themes.l3: L3 regal surfaces (the Mese, the Spire, Palace Row, the Ministry)
themes.l2: L2 common surfaces (Gate, Bazaar, Stacks, Hearth, Foundry, Lantern)
themes.props: stage 8's brush props with no on-client face (locker, MSR lamp head)
themes.mega: the mega-structure: deck underside, piers, girders, trusses, pipes, outer walls, service lights (no material in the spec yet)
themes.insurgents: the insurgents' marks, slogans, defaced posters, banner
themes.signs: building signs, street plates, trade signs, neon frames
themes.decals: grime and rain as masked textures on thin detail brushes (infodecal reads decals.wad only)

Marble016.note: dark grey marble, fine white veins: MSR walls

Marble017.note: dark grey marble, rougher: MSR floors

Marble006.note: near-black marble, grey clouds: MSR floor inlay, trims' backing

Concrete028.note: cast concrete with form lines: piers

Metal021.note: blue-grey painted steel, rust leaks: cladding, girders, bands

Metal038.note: scratched grey steel: trusses, pipes, bars, lamp housing

CorrugatedSteel009.note: dark corrugated steel (the photo is 2:1): steel deck soffit

Plaster003.note: rough clean plaster: L3 stucco, tinted ochre

Planks023A.note: dark planks: red-lacquer panelling (colourised), timber rails

Concrete017.note: clean dark smooth concrete: polished cement wall, glass, puddles, the canal's water

Concrete016.note: clean light smooth concrete: polished cement floor

CorrugatedSteel007A.note: blue painted corrugated steel: rolling shutter slats

Fabric030.note: grey woven cloth: canopy (stripes drawn over)

Bricks062.note: grungy brick wall (ambientCG gives 1.05 m): drawn at three times its size so a course is about 8 texels and reads at GoldSrc scale

Bricks105.note: rough beige brick (the photo is 2:1), drawn at twice its size so a course reads: the sewer vault, darkened and greened

Concrete032.note: bunker concrete with green mould: canal vault

PavingStones127.note: dark paving blocks: wet quay slabs

Rope003.note: rope: lashings on a timber rail

SurfaceImperfections011.note: water stains: grime decal mask (its luminance)

SurfaceImperfections012.note: water stains: puddle mask, scum on the canal

materialMap: each texture's `serves` lists the spec materials (levels/specs/newbyzantium.json `materials`) it stands for; `role:` entries are roles the spec does not have yet (the mega-structure), `sign:` a building's sign id, `prop:` a stage-8 prop kind, `decal:`/`water:` kit-only uses
